default: [![M8ven Score](https://m8ven.ai/badge/mcp/jsifalda-signalseek-mcp-14ersf?v=ae70c2dc1b2e59414ee0db2cb8799155)](https://m8ven.ai/mcp/jsifalda-signalseek-mcp-14ersf?s=readme) # SignalSeek MCP server Reddit lead monitoring for AI agents. SignalSeek watches Reddit for people who describe the problem your product solves, scores each thread, and drafts a reply. You read the matches and drafts from Claude, then you write the reply yourself on Reddit. **SignalSeek never posts.** The server has no posting tool of any kind. - Endpoint: `https://signalseek.cc/api/mcp` - Transport: streamable HTTP - Auth: OAuth. You sign in to your own SignalSeek account. Claude reaches that one account and no other. - Registry name: `io.github.jsifalda/signalseek` in the [official MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=signalseek) - Website: [signalseek.cc](https://signalseek.cc) · Connector page: [signalseek.cc/mcp](https://signalseek.cc/mcp) ## Connect in Claude 1. Open Claude on the web or in the Desktop app. 2. Pro and Max: open **Customize**, then **Connectors**, then **+ Add**, then **Add custom connector**. 3. Enter a name and the URL `https://signalseek.cc/api/mcp`. Paste `/api/mcp`, not `/mcp`. Click **Continue**. 4. Under OAuth client, keep **Use Claude's published identity (Recommended)**. Click **Add**, then **Connect**. 5. Sign in to SignalSeek and approve. 6. Ask Claude: "List my SignalSeek campaigns." Team and Enterprise: an Owner adds the connector under **Organization settings → Connectors → Add → Custom → Web**. Members then click **Connect** under **Customize → Connectors**. The connector syncs to your account, so it also works in the Claude iOS app. ## Connect in Google Antigravity This repo is an Antigravity plugin (`plugin.json`, `mcp_config.json`). 1. Install the plugin from this repo, or from the Antigravity Marketplace when it is listed. 2. Antigravity opens your browser when the server connects. Sign in to SignalSeek and approve. 3. Ask: "List my SignalSeek campaigns." ## Connect in Gemini CLI This repo is a Gemini CLI extension (`gemini-extension.json`). ```bash gemini extensions install https://github.com/jsifalda/signalseek-mcp ``` Then run `/mcp auth signalseek`, sign in to SignalSeek and approve. ## Other MCP clients Point the client at `https://signalseek.cc/api/mcp` over streamable HTTP. The server does not support OAuth dynamic client registration. Use a client that supports OAuth client ID metadata documents, or set a client ID by hand. The `clients/` folder holds the published client ID documents for Gemini CLI and Antigravity. Each file's raw GitHub URL is its client ID. ## Tools | Tool | What it does | Access | |---|---|---| | `list_campaigns` | Lists your campaigns with status, interval and match counts | Read | | `get_campaign` | Reads one campaign in full, plus its strategy summary | Read | | `get_campaign_strategy` | Reads a campaign's persona, subreddits and search terms. A search term reports `isExcluded` and `autoExcluded` | Read | | `get_campaign_stats` | Reads a campaign's draft counts and last monitoring run | Read | | `list_drafts` | Lists the Reddit opportunities SignalSeek found, with a summary of each draft | Read | | `get_draft` | Reads one draft in full | Read | | `create_campaign` | Creates a campaign and, by default, generates its strategy | Write | | `generate_campaign_strategy` | Generates search terms, subreddits and a reply persona for a draft campaign | Write | | `update_campaign` | Changes a campaign's settings or status (pause, resume, archive) | Write | | `update_persona` | Changes a campaign's reply persona | Write | | `add_subreddits` | Adds subreddits to a campaign, each checked against Reddit first | Write | | `update_subreddit` | Excludes, restores or removes one subreddit. Remove works only on subreddits you added | Write | | `add_search_terms` | Adds search terms to a campaign | Write | | `update_search_term` | Excludes, restores or removes one search term, and restores one that the daily job auto-excluded | Write | | `generate_draft_reply` | Writes the reply for a draft and stores it on that draft | Write | | `approve_draft` | Marks a draft approved inside SignalSeek. It does not post | Write | | `reject_draft` | Turns a draft down, with an optional tag and reason that tune later matches | Write | "Write" tools change data inside your SignalSeek account only. No tool writes to Reddit. ## Things you can ask - "What came in overnight?" - "Show me the draft for the best match." - "Create a SignalSeek campaign for my invoicing app. It is for freelance designers who hate chasing late payments." - "Pause the campaign for the product I shut down." ## Privacy - SignalSeek reads public Reddit content. It never posts, comments or sends messages. - Each OAuth token is tied to one SignalSeek account. - Pricing and terms: [signalseek.cc](https://signalseek.cc) ## About this repo This repo holds the public docs, the MCP Registry manifest (`server.json`), the Gemini CLI extension, the Antigravity plugin and their OAuth client ID documents. The server itself is a hosted service, and its source is private. ## License MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
